title: Unit 21 Consolidation: Economic Cycles, Crisis & Adaptation

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can express multiplicative expansion (-szorosára nő) and proportional relations (arányban áll) accurately
I can utilize rate and degree adverbials (mértékben, ütemben, arányában) to describe business cycles
I can formulate comparative magnitudes (kétszer akkora) and fractional reductions (felére esik)
I can synthesize macroeconomic data, crisis adaptation, and historical case studies in advanced writing
